summary: This Form 6-K, filed by Nomura Holdings Inc. under Rule 13a-16, contains an English translation of an Extraordinary Report submitted to Japanese regulators following the company's 122nd Annual General Meeting of Shareholders on June 23, 2026. The report details the approval of 11 director appointments, including Koji Nagai, Kentaro Okuda, and others, with vote results showing approval ratios between 90.4% and 98.1%. The filing is a routine post-meeting disclosure required under Japanese financial law, not a special situation. No transaction, activist campaign, or strategic change is involved.
